steps.message:
FILES: rich/cells.py:10
ROOT CAUSE: The regex `_is_single_cell_widths` used to detect strings containing only single-width characters is missing some common ranges, which prevents the "fast path" in `set_cell_size` from being taken for many common strings, hurting performance.
CHANGE: Update `_is_single_cell_widths` regex to include a more comprehensive range of single-width characters. Based on common needs for this fix in similar libraries, the regex should be expanded. A common fix is `re.compile(r"^[ \u0020-\u007f\u00a0-\u00ff\u0100-\u024f\u0370-\u04ff]*$")` or similar, but looking at the current `\u0020-\u006f\u00a0\u02ff\u0370-\u0482`, it is very restrictive (it ends at 'o' `\u006f` and misses many characters). I will expand it to cover the basic ASCII range and common Latin-1.
TEST: tests/test_cells.py
